 3 arrested after police chase ends in crash in Royal Oak
 Suspects could face multiple felony charges in connection to pursuit
 Noelle Gray , Digital Content Producer
 Published:  November 16, 2026 at 7:15 AM Updated:  November 16, 2026 at 1:35 PM Tags:  Royal Oak , Oakland County , Detroit , Wayne County ROYAL OAK, Mich. – Michigan State Police say three people are in custody following a chase across Metro Detroit early Monday morning.
 The incident started around 5:17 a.m. on Nov. 16 when the Detroit Police Department sent out information regarding a recently stolen vehicle, with armed suspects inside.
 Michigan State Police troopers located the vehicle near State Fair and Orleans Street in Detroit.
 The vehicle initially stopped for troopers, but when officers attempted to conduct a felony traffic stop, the driver sped off, leading troopers on a pursuit into the City of Royal Oak.
 The chase ended near Lincoln Drive and Altadena Avenue between Main and Campbell Roads after a trooper successfully performed a PIT maneuver to stop the vehicle.
 According to police, the driver ran away before troopers were able to capture them. The two remaining suspects were taken into custody.
 During the chase, the suspect vehicle hit a home, causing minimal damage. No firearms were recovered.
 Michigan State Police will be seeking multiple felony charges in connection with the chase.
 An investigation into what happened remains ongoing.
